title: Algebraic Degree of Inverse ChiChi Components
summary: For even integers m, each nontrivial inverse ChiChi component has algebraic degree at least m; whether every such component always has degree exactly m remains open.

formal_statement.body: For the inverse of $\chi\chi_{2m}$, where $m$ is an even integer, determine whether every non-trivial component has algebraic degree exactly $m$. The established baseline is that the algebraic degree of each such component is at least $m$; the unresolved issue is whether this lower bound is always tight for every non-trivial component and every even $m$. The equality has been verified computationally for dimensions $n \le 32$ when $n$ is a multiple of $4$, but a proof or counterexample for the universal claim remains open.

scope.domain: Boolean and vectorial Boolean functions, focused on algebraic degrees of inverse ChiChi components.
parameters: m: indexes the inverse ChiChi family and is the conjectured component degree
n: dimension used in computational verification, restricted there to multiples of 4 up to 32
scope.unresolved_remainder: Prove that every non-trivial inverse ChiChi component has algebraic degree exactly m for every even m, or find a counterexample.

citations.label: ChiLow and ChiChi: New Constructions for Code Encryption

progress.summary: The paper establishes the degree lower bound m and reports computational equality for dimensions at most 32 that are multiples of 4. It presents the universal equality as Conjecture 1.
